label: Asset
help: The asset to render. Pick one from your library, or paste a lolly.tools tool link. Vector assets stay vector through SVG and PDF; raster assets embed as images.

label: Fit
help: Contain shows the whole asset inside the frame; Cover fills the frame and may crop the edges.

label: Background
help: The colour behind the asset. Turn on "Transparent background" to drop it.

label: Transparent background
help: Drop the background fill so the asset exports on transparency (PNG/SVG/WebP).
